info.description:
API for WSO services like factrak, facebook, dormtrak, and others.

Errors: failed requests return the real HTTP status, with a body of the form
`{"status": <HTTP status>, "error": {"errorCode": <WSO code>, "message": "...", "errors": [...]}}`.
Clients should branch on `error.errorCode`. Per-endpoint `@Failure` entries list the WSO codes
an endpoint can return under its HTTP status, as `code: message`.

Auth: every endpoint marked with the Bearer security scheme may return 401 (missing or invalid token)
and 403 with errorCode 1330 (token lacks the required scope). These are not repeated per endpoint.
